paite: TOUPA na Pathian un agam uh nou ahon piak namte TOUPA'N ahihmanthat khopite na luah ua, a-innte ua na ten chiang un;
heading: Kihumbitna Khopite / (Nam 35.9-34; Jos 20.1-9)

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia nou ahon piakna gam ah nou a ding in khopi thum na sep ding uhi.
Huai khopite zotna ding lampite sial unla, TOUPA'N hon luahsak ding gam seh thum suah un. Huchi in mi that kha kuapeuh huaite ah atailut thei ding uhi.
Huai a tailutmi that kha bit thei ding hiaite ahi: Mi a-invengte tuma lam a huatna leng nei khol lou a that kha peuhmahte;
a-invengte toh sing phuk dia gamlak a kuan, asing phuk dia aheipi asat a, heipi tang kitol in a-invengte adenlup khakte ahi ding ua hiai khopite lak a khatpeuh ah atai thei ding uh;
sisan phulami in ahehna apai lai a mithat mi pen delh a, lampi asau ziak a delhpha in ava satlum kha ding hi. Tuma lam a huatna na nei khol lou ahih ziak in si tak ahi kei hi.
Huaiziak in Khopi thum nou a ding in na sep ding uh, chi in thu ka hon pia hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiam bang a na pi-le-pute uh piak ana chiam gam ahon piak a;
TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh alampi zui gige ding a, tuni a ka hon thupiak tengteng na zuih uleh hiai khopi thumte sim louh in nou a ding in khopi thum dang na behlap nawn ding uhi.
Hiai bel TOUPA'N luah ding a ahon piak na gamsung ua poi khoih lou sisan suah a-om louh a, na tung ua sisan a-omlouhna ding ahi.
Himahleh mi'n a-invengte ahuat a, atan a, asual a, si khop hial a avuak a, huai khopite lak a khat a ataileh;
akho upate un mi sawl uhenla, huai mipa va pi uhenla, hihlup ding in sisan phulami khut ah pekhia uhen.
Amah na hehpih ding uh ahi kei a, nou a dia hoih ding in Israel gam a pan poi khoih lou sisan suahna na hihmang ding uh ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak gam ah, ana phuhsa uh na invengte gamgi na suan ding uh ahi kei.
heading: Tang Lai Gamgite

paite: Mi athulimlouhna hiam, akhelhna himhim hiam theihpih khat ahun kei dia; theihpih nih kam hiam, theihpih thum kam hiam a thu hihkip ding ahi.
heading: Theihpihtute Toh Kisai

paite: Mi khatpeuh thil hihkhial a ngoh dia tup gilou nei theihpihmi adinleh,
huai bang a kingohna neite gel TOUPA ma leh huai hun a siampute leh vaihawmte ma ah adingh tuak ding uhi.
Vaihawmte'n ngenteltak in thu adong ding ua, ngai in, theihpihmi thu theihpih zuau ahih a, a-unau zuau a ngoh ahihleh;
a-unau tung a hih atup bangbang amah tung ah na hih ding uh. Huchibang in na lak ua thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
Midangte'n aza ding ua, alau ding ua, huchi in tunung chiang in huchibang thil hoih lou mawngmawng na lak uah ahih nawn kei ding uhi.
Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei. Hinna tang in hinna, mit tang in mit, ha tang in ha, khut tang in khut, khe tang in khe ahi ding ahi.
